title: 第四章 这家伙真没救了
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“呵呵，怎么样？这些可都是过去费因最受欢迎最畅销的小说，都出自我之手哦。”亚枫很自豪的说道。

“你，你是说，现在王国的人们都在看这些书吗...”伊尔莎问道。

“嗯哼。”

“王国完蛋了...”

伊尔莎莫名感觉到一阵悲哀。

“唉，可惜我现在被行业封杀了，已经写不了书了。”亚枫叹了口气。

这点，伊尔莎倒觉得不奇怪....

亚枫当初离开王宫后，如何在异世界生存是个问题，虽然自己靠着上辈子的经验，随便传授点魔法学知识都能在霍因莱尔魔法学院成为最顶尖的学者，但他已经决定这一次不再和王国任何官方组织有联系，万一暴露真实水平，指不定就会跑来用道德绑架让自己回去重新成为勇者。

再三思索下，他突然就想到了个行当，

王国除了一些正经文学出版社，还有一个名叫满天星的杂志社，以周刊的形式，专门发布一些俗套但更符合普罗大众口味的小说。

这给亚枫找到了方向，过去总爱看点小说，虽然自己文笔不咋地，但只要剧情够好，一样买的火爆，

当即就给满天星出版社投了稿，很快就在新一期杂刊上发表了第一篇文章。

《斗萝大陆》！

原本的魔法学院的天才肖恩却一夜之间陨落成魔之力三段的绝世废柴！还被世家大小姐当众退婚打脸！忍辱负重之下，才发现是母亲给自己的戒指里藏了一个不知道多少岁的白毛魔女天天吸他的魔力，为了弥补魔女就教他炼制魔药修炼法术最后成为顶级的大魔法师最后和白毛魔女过上没羞没臊的生活。

这来自21世纪的新鲜货对这些异世界的人来说简直降维打击，一经发布立刻成为爆款，直接当了杂刊封面，后面更是出版，签售，翻拍舞台剧，漫画，连续剧，影剧，吊打经典文学畅销榜，成为茶余饭后的经典。

随后更是连着出版好几部小说，把那些什么挖坟啊，屠龙啊，炼蛊啊，还有各种异世界厕纸，退队流，背叛流，重生流啥的都搬过来了，有些连本土化改编都不需要直接照搬，两年时间写了十多本书！

本来混的风生水起的，钞票大把大把的赚，结果他自己沉不住气，在成为大热门后自然多了不少批评的声音，大多是那些经典文学的拥护者，都在骂他写的东西低俗星压抑难登大雅之堂，骂他是个死luoli控女主全是小女孩，今年诺文的的名人堂给他简直就是黑幕，

其他都算了，他妈的诺文名人堂大奖是自己凭实力得来的怎么就黑幕了？

于是他直接与这些人激情对喷，狠狠的反击，

"Haha, how about it? These are Fein's most popular and best-selling novels in the past, and they are all written by me." Yafeng said very proudly.

"You, you mean, people in the kingdom are reading these books now..." Ilsa asked.

"Uh-huh."

"The kingdom is over..."

Ilsa felt an inexplicable sadness.

"Alas, it's a pity that I have been banned from the industry and can no longer write books." Ya Feng sighed.

Ilsa doesn't find this surprising...

After Yafeng left the palace, how to survive in a different world was a problem. Although he could become the top scholar at Hoinler Magic Academy by relying on his experience in his previous life and imparting some magic knowledge, he had decided not to have any contact with any official organization in the kingdom this time. If his true level was exposed, he might come and use moral kidnapping to make him go back and become a brave man again.

After thinking about it again and again, he suddenly thought of a business,

In addition to some serious literary publishing houses, the Kingdom also has a magazine called Stars and Stars, which publishes some clichéd novels that are more in line with the taste of the general public in the form of a weekly.

This gave Yafeng a direction. In the past, he always liked to read novels. Although his writing skills were not good, as long as the plot was good enough, the books were still popular.

I immediately submitted my manuscript to Gypsophila Publishing House, and soon published the first article in a new issue of the magazine.

"Douluo Continent"!

Sean, who was originally a genius at the Magic Academy, fell overnight and became a peerless loser with third-level demonic power!He was also slapped in the face by the eldest lady of a family who broke off the engagement in public!After enduring the humiliation, he discovered that the ring given to him by his mother contained a white-haired witch of unknown age who sucked his magic power every day. In order to make up for it, the witch taught him to refine potions and practice spells, and finally became a top magician. Finally, he and the white-haired witch lived a life without shame.

This fresh product from the 21st century was a dimensionality-reducing blow to people from this other world. Once it was released, it immediately became a hit, and it directly became the cover of magazines. Later, it was published, signed, and remade into stage plays, comics, TV series, and movie dramas. It hit the best-seller list of classic literature and became an after-dinner classic.

Subsequently, he published several novels in succession, including things like digging graves, slaying dragons, refining Gu, and various toilet paper from other worlds, quitting the team, betrayal, and rebirth. Some of them didn't even need to be copied directly for local adaptation. He wrote more than ten books in two years!

He was originally prosperous and making a lot of money, but he couldn't calm down. After becoming a big hit, there were naturally a lot of criticisms. Most of them were supporters of classic literature. They all scolded him for writing things that were vulgar and depressing, and called him a cunning and controlling heroine. All the heroines were little girls. This year's Hall of Fame for Novin gave him a shady reputation.

Forget everything else, why is it so shady that he won the fucking Noven Hall of Fame Award because of his own strength?

So he directly confronted these people passionately and fought back fiercely,
